chapter: Early 1930s: Bessie Smith, Rex Stewart and the Harlem scene
title: Rex Stewart band personnel
summary: Ramirez lists the Rex Stewart band: Edgar Sampson on violin, two violins, saxes, Ward Pinkett, Sid Catlett, Earl McGee and others.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, let's get back now to when you joined Rex Stewart's band. Who was in that you?
Yeah. He was playing violin. Noel Cluckies -- he owns a hotel in St. Lucia now! He lived in Harlem. He was the son of a preacher.
Yeah, we had two violins. And then we had Rudy (what was his name?)...Rudy Bow(?), alto. Arthur Beebe(?) played baritone and sang. U.S. Scott, alto.

Then we had Thigpen and Ward Pinkett. Nelson Harding on trombone. Sid Catlett on drums. Ahmed(?) Canty on guitar. And then on bass we had Earl McGee, who came from the Louisiana Stompers. And Rex, of course. And Sonny White...
Oh, he sang. He sang with Luis Russell later on.
